frnsw-hiker-rescue-2026.title: Two hikers found and guided to safety
frnsw-hiker-rescue-2026.synopsis: Drone operators identified two overdue hikers. Ground teams guided both to safety.
frnsw-hiker-rescue-2026.comparator: No search without AI was reported.
frnsw-hiker-rescue-2026.qualification: AI’s separate contribution, time saved, and injuries avoided were not established.

grass-valley-fire-alert-2023.title: Fire alert before the first 911 call
grass-valley-fire-alert-2023.result_label: Between AI alert and first 911 call
grass-valley-fire-alert-2023.synopsis: Firefighters were already on scene when the first 911 call arrived. The fire stayed below a quarter acre.
grass-valley-fire-alert-2023.comparator: The AI alert at 05:19 versus the first 911 call at 06:01.
grass-valley-fire-alert-2023.qualification: The interval does not establish time saved or losses avoided.

visual.caption: Observed interval, not a measure of time saved.

create-case-1-lung-cancer.title: An incidental lung cancer diagnosis
create-case-1-lung-cancer.result_label: Following an incidental lung cancer diagnosis
create-case-1-lung-cancer.synopsis: A flagged lung nodule led to investigation, a stage IB diagnosis, and surgery for one patient.
create-case-1-lung-cancer.comparator: No comparison establishes what would have happened without AI.
create-case-1-lung-cancer.qualification: No survival benefit established. AstraZeneca funded the study. One author worked for Qure.ai.

visual.caption: One patient in the CREATE case series.

royal-surrey-lung-cancer-triage.title: Same-day contact after a chest X-ray
royal-surrey-lung-cancer-triage.synopsis: Hospital staff reviewed an AI-prioritized X-ray and contacted the patient. Further investigation identified stage I lung cancer.
royal-surrey-lung-cancer-triage.comparator: No comparison establishes contact timing or cancer stage without AI.
royal-surrey-lung-cancer-triage.qualification: Treatment and longer-term outcomes were unreported. AI’s effect on cancer stage or survival was not established.

visual.caption: One patient’s pathway, reported by Royal Surrey.

sussex-stroke-treatment-2021.title: Returning to daily life after stroke
sussex-stroke-treatment-2021.synopsis: After clot-removal surgery, Carol Wilson returned home and later resumed work, exercise, and childcare.
sussex-stroke-treatment-2021.comparator: No comparison separates AI from emergency response, surgery, and other care.
sussex-stroke-treatment-2021.qualification: AI’s contribution to this patient’s recovery was not isolated.

visual.caption: Daily activities resumed later. AI’s separate effect was not measured.

harvard-physics-tutor-2023.title: Higher scores after physics tutoring
harvard-physics-tutor-2023.result_label: Standard deviations higher on immediate physics tests
harvard-physics-tutor-2023.synopsis: Students scored higher after two lessons with an AI tutor and instructor-prepared materials.
harvard-physics-tutor-2023.comparator: The AI tutor and teaching materials versus classroom active learning.
harvard-physics-tutor-2023.qualification: One course, two lessons. Retention and later transfer were not assessed.

visual.caption: Adjusted effect for the tutor and materials versus classroom active learning.

rows.label: standard deviations higher on immediate physics tests

ithaca-historians-2022.title: Reconstructing ancient text with Ithaca
ithaca-historians-2022.synopsis: Two Greek epigraphy specialists reconstructed masked known text more accurately when using Ithaca’s suggestions.
ithaca-historians-2022.comparator: 25.3% unaided, on masked text whose original wording was known.
ithaca-historians-2022.qualification: Two evaluators. Performance on masked known text does not establish accuracy on genuinely unknown inscriptions.

visual.caption: Reconstruction accuracy on deliberately masked ancient Greek text whose original wording was known.

customer-support-assistant-2020.title: More customer issues resolved per hour
customer-support-assistant-2020.result_label: Estimated increase in resolutions per hour
customer-support-assistant-2020.synopsis: A study of 5,172 support agents at one company estimated higher productivity after AI assistance became available.
customer-support-assistant-2020.comparator: Agents before and after access, compared with agents without access.
customer-support-assistant-2020.qualification: The estimate depends on comparison assumptions. Gains varied by experience and skill.

visual.caption: Estimated change in one company’s nonrandomized rollout.

rows.label: estimated increase in resolutions per hour

professional-writing-chatgpt-2023.title: Less time on professional writing tasks
professional-writing-chatgpt-2023.result_label: Less time on the tested writing tasks
professional-writing-chatgpt-2023.synopsis: In a randomized experiment with 453 professionals, ChatGPT access shortened task time and raised assessed writing quality by 18%.
professional-writing-chatgpt-2023.comparator: Random assignment to ChatGPT guidance versus a control group, some of whom also used ChatGPT.
professional-writing-chatgpt-2023.qualification: Short tasks required neither precise factual accuracy nor organization-specific knowledge. Whole-job productivity was not measured.

visual.caption: Two outcomes from the randomized writing experiment.

rows.label: less time on the tested tasks

copilot-http-server-2022.title: A coding task completed sooner
copilot-http-server-2022.result_label: Less time, among successful completers only
copilot-http-server-2022.synopsis: Developers assigned Copilot built a JavaScript HTTP server faster, comparing the 35 successful completers in each group.
copilot-http-server-2022.comparator: 71.17 versus 160.89 minutes among completers assigned Copilot or no Copilot.
copilot-http-server-2022.qualification: One task. Completion-rate difference was not statistically significant. Broader quality, security, and maintenance were not assessed.

visual.caption: Average time to build a JavaScript HTTP server, among successful completers only.
